applicability_conditions: Applicable to the yield stress point (subscript o) of the flow stress curve, described by the Sellars–Tegart–Garofalo (STG) model.
purpose: Defines the yield stress σ_0 using the Sellars–Tegart–Garofalo (STG) model, expressing it as the sum of an athermal stress and a thermal component written in terms of the temperature-compensated strain rate Z_0.

symbols.meaning: material constant of the equivalent thermal component
deformation activation energy at the yield stress point of the flow curve
